title: सप्ताधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Garuda describes the southern quarter, the realm of Yama and the ancestors, where sages laid down the bounds of conduct and the righteous and the wicked receive their due.
summary.kn: ಯಮ ಮತ್ತು ಪಿತೃಗಳ ರಾಜ್ಯವಾದ, ಋಷಿಗಳು ನಡತೆಯ ಮಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ಥಾಪಿಸಿದ, ಧರ್ಮಿಷ್ಠರೂ ದುಷ್ಟರೂ ತಮ್ಮ ಫಲ ಪಡೆಯುವ ದಕ್ಷಿಣದಿಕ್ಕನ್ನು ಗರುಡನು ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: गरुड़ दक्षिण दिशा का वर्णन करते हैं, जो यम और पितरों का लोक है, जहाँ ऋषियों ने आचरण की मर्यादाएँ स्थापित कीं और धर्मात्मा तथा दुष्ट अपना फल पाते हैं।
summary.te: యముడు, పితరుల రాజ్యమైన, ఋషులు ప్రవర్తనా మర్యాదలను స్థాపించిన, ధర్మాత్ములూ దుష్టులూ తమ ఫలాన్ని పొందే దక్షిణ దిక్కును గరుడుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: யமனுக்கும் பித்ருக்களுக்கும் உரிய, முனிவர்கள் ஒழுக்க வரம்புகளை நிறுவிய, அறவோரும் தீயோரும் தம் பலனைப் பெறும் தெற்குத் திசையைக் கருடன் விவரிக்கிறான்.
summary.ml: യമന്റെയും പിതൃക്കളുടെയും ലോകമായ തെക്കൻ ദിക്ക് ഗരുഡൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു; അവിടെയാണ് മുനിമാർ ആചാരമര്യാദകളുടെ അതിരുകൾ നിശ്ചയിച്ചത്, നീതിമാന്മാർക്കും ദുഷ്ടന്മാർക്കും അവരവർക്ക് അർഹമായത് ലഭിക്കുന്നത്.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.107; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: सुपर्ण उवाच

meaning.en: Suparna said:

verses.text:
इयं विवस्वता पूर्वं श्रौतेन विधिना किल ।
गुरवे दक्षिणा दत्ता दक्षिणेत्युच्यतेऽथ दिक् ॥

meaning.en: 'This is the direction in which Vivasvan once, by the Vedic rite, gave his fee to his teacher, so it is called Dakshina, the south.

verses.text:
अत्र लोकत्रयस्यास्य पितृपक्षः प्रतिष्ठितः ।
अत्रोष्मपानां देवानां निवासः श्रूयते द्विज ॥

meaning.en: Here the side of the ancestors for the three worlds is established, and here, brahmin, the heat-drinking gods are said to dwell.

verses.text:
अत्र विश्वे सदा देवाः पितृभिः सार्धमासते ।
इज्यमानाः स्म लोकेषु संप्राप्तास्तुल्यभागताम् ॥

meaning.en: Here the Vishvedevas always sit with the ancestors; when worshipped in the worlds they have attained an equal share.

verses.text:
एतद्द्वितीयं धर्मस्य द्वारमाचक्षते द्विज ।
त्रुटिशो लवशश्चात्र गण्यते कालनिश्चयः ॥

meaning.en: They call this the second gate of Dharma, brahmin. Here the reckoning of time is made by moments and instants.

verses.text:
अत्र देवर्षयो नित्यं पितृलोकर्षयस्तथा ।
तथा राजर्षयः सर्वे निवसन्ति गतव्यथाः ॥

meaning.en: Here the divine sages always live, as do the sages of the world of the ancestors and all the royal sages, free of distress.

verses.text:
अत्र धर्मश्च सत्यं च कर्म चात्र निशाम्यते ।
गतिरेषा द्विजश्रेष्ठ कर्मणात्मावसादिनः ॥

meaning.en: Here Dharma, truth and action are weighed. This is the destination, best of brahmins, of one who is sunk by his actions.

verses.text:
एषा दिक्सा द्विजश्रेष्ठ यां सर्वः प्रतिपद्यते ।
वृता त्वनवबोधेन सुखं तेन न गम्यते ॥

meaning.en: This is the direction that all must come to; but because it is veiled by ignorance, it is not reached happily.

verses.text:
नैरृतानां सहस्राणि बहून्यत्र द्विजर्षभ ।
सृष्टानि प्रतिकूलानि द्रष्टव्यान्यकृतात्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: Here, bull among brahmins, thousands upon thousands of hostile Nairritas have been created, to be seen by those of unformed selves.

verses.text:
अत्र मन्दरकुञ्जेषु विप्रर्षिसदनेषु च ।
गन्धर्वा गान्ति गाथा वै चित्तबुद्धिहरा द्विज ॥

meaning.en: Here, in the groves of Mandara and in the dwellings of brahmin sages, Gandharvas sing songs that steal away thought and understanding.

verses.text:
अत्र सामानि गाथाभिः श्रुत्वा गीतानि रैवतः ।
गतदारो गतामात्यो गतराज्यो वनं गतः ॥

meaning.en: Here Raivata, hearing Samans sung with songs, left his wife, ministers and kingdom and went to the forest.

verses.text:
अत्र सावर्णिना चैव यवक्रीतात्मजेन च ।
मर्यादा स्थापिता ब्रह्मन्यां सूर्यो नातिवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: Here the limit that the sun does not cross was set by Savarni and the son of Yavakrita, brahmin.

verses.text:
अत्र राक्षसराजेन पौलस्त्येन महात्मना ।
रावणेन तपश्चीर्त्वा सुरेभ्योऽमरता वृता ॥

meaning.en: Here Ravana, descendant of Pulastya and king of the rakshasas, practiced austerity and chose immortality from the gods.

verses.text:
अत्र वृत्तेन वृत्रोऽपि शक्रशत्रुत्वमीयिवान् ।
अत्र सर्वासवः प्राप्ताः पुनर्गच्छन्ति पञ्चधा ॥

meaning.en: Here Vritra, through his conduct, became Indra's enemy; here all the vital breaths that arrive depart again in five ways.

verses.text:
अत्र दुष्कृतकर्माणो नराः पच्यन्ति गालव ।
अत्र वैतरणी नाम नदी वितरणैर्वृता ।
अत्र गत्वा सुखस्यान्तं दुःखस्यान्तं प्रपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Here evildoers are cooked, Galava. Here flows the river named Vaitarani, filled with gifts. Having come here, one reaches the end of happiness and the end of sorrow.

verses.text:
अत्रावृत्तो दिनकरः क्षरते सुरसं पयः ।
काष्ठां चासाद्य धानिष्ठां हिममुत्सृजते पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Here the sun, turning back, pours down sweet-tasting water, and on reaching the Dhanishtha region he releases frost again.

verses.text:
अत्राहं गालव पुरा क्षुधार्तः परिचिन्तयन् ।
लब्धवान्युध्यमानौ द्वौ बृहन्तौ गजकच्छपौ ॥

meaning.en: Here, Galava, long ago I, tormented by hunger and brooding, found two huge creatures fighting, an elephant and a tortoise.

verses.text:
अत्र शक्रधनुर्नाम सूर्याज्जातो महानृषिः ।
विदुर्यं कपिलं देवं येनात्ताः सगरात्मजाः ॥

meaning.en: Here the great sage named Shakradhanus was born of the sun; they know him as the divine Kapila, by whom the sons of Sagara were consumed.

verses.text:
अत्र सिद्धाः शिवा नाम ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः ।
अधीत्य सखिलान्वेदानालभन्ते यमक्षयम् ॥

meaning.en: Here the blessed brahmins called Siddhas, masters of the Vedas, having studied all the Vedas, reach the abode of Yama.

verses.text:
अत्र भोगवती नाम पुरी वासुकिपालिता ।
तक्षकेण च नागेन तथैवैरावतेन च ॥

meaning.en: Here is the city called Bhogavati, ruled by Vasuki, the serpent Takshaka and likewise Airavata.

verses.text:
अत्र निर्याणकालेषु तमः संप्राप्यते महत् ।
अभेद्यं भास्करेणापि स्वयं वा कृष्णवर्त्मना ॥

meaning.en: Here at the times of departure a great darkness is reached, which not even the sun can pierce, nor the dark-pathed fire himself.

verses.text:
एष तस्यापि ते मार्गः परितापस्य गालव ।
ब्रूहि मे यदि गन्तव्यं प्रतीचीं शृणु वा मम ॥

meaning.en: This is the way for that distress of yours too, Galava. Tell me if we must go there; or hear of the west.'
